children.text:
OpenAI is such a mess atm:

1. They created chat + work split in June / July, now they are combining them back later this year.

2. Their 28-days-of-shipping-or-reset was embarrassing. I think over half were resets.

3. They finally, right at the end, flip-flopped on 100/200/500 plan usage. Also, those names won't scale with inflation.

4. I see _eight_ (8!) models in my codex model selector.

5. _All_ their produce announcements (codex, chat, work, dots, agents) have the same messaging: "extra capabilities designed for long running tasks" - so which do I choose!?

I mean, I know it's a new technology and products are evolving, but...

title: OpenAI: We are doubling all usage limits for all Pro 100/200/500 tiers
